items: Read-only audit of the Factory's prior LOCK discipline: found 15 *_LOCKED_STATE.md files, none machine-checked after the day they were written -- one directly claimed the exact Coloring Book captions-off behavior that had just regressed and shipped to a live customer.

Built command_center/function_lock_registry.json as the new single source of truth: 4 functions LOCKED with real, git-verified last_known_good_commits (Word Search a021385, Coloring Book 984b268, Crossword e81298e, Invite protection 0a9a713); 7 PROTECTED; none falsely marked LOCKED or UNPROTECTED.

Added tests/test_function_lock_registry_integrity.py (registry honesty: real commits, protected tests exist and are in the manifest, consistent unlock/relock metadata) and tests/test_function_lock_enforcement.py (blocks an unauthorized change to a LOCKED function's files or shared dependencies).

Owner correctly identified a real gap: the first enforcement version only compared the working tree to HEAD, so it stopped protecting the moment a change was committed. Strengthened it to diff from each dependency's own durable baseline (the newest last_known_good_commit among every function, LOCKED or UNLOCKED, that shares that file) -- proven correct against this repo's real history, not assumed.

Proved enforcement with temporary, fully-reverted commits: an already-committed change to coloring_book's own file failed and named it; an already-committed change to the shared static/js/app.js failed and named all three sharing functions (word_search, coloring_book, crossword); the full UNLOCK -> CHANGE -> PROTECTED TESTS -> RELOCK workflow was run end-to-end and enforcement passed cleanly afterward. A real bug found during this proof (unlocking one function was dropping its LKG from siblings' shared-dependency baseline, falsely re-flagging them) was fixed on the spot.

Surfaced a Function Lock Matrix in the Command Center (command_center/status.py, templates/command_center.html) showing status, last-known-good commit, and gate coverage per function; confirmed rendering correctly.
Wired both new tests into tests/acceptance_manifest.json, CLAUDE.md's Fast Stability Gate command, and the external RUN_FACTORY_STABILITY_GATE.bat launcher.

Ran Full Release Gate (2774 tests, 0 failures) and Fast Stability Gate (160 passed, 696 subtests) with the final strengthened logic in place. No customer-facing code (app.py, services/*, customer templates/JS) was touched. Committed as 7b22eb9 and pushed to origin/main.
